ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the image, what is an herbivore?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. Inside the central black frame, green aquatic plants or algae are shown. Below the central plant frame there is a small insect, and there is an arrow pointing from the plant frame to this insect. There are also fish and other aquatic organisms around the diagram, connected by arrows. Reasoning: In a food web, plants or algae are producers, and animals that eat plants or producers are herbivores. In the diagram, the insect directly obtains food from the plants/algae, so the herbivore is the insect.
